audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text repeatedly claims Counter Strike (E) 'soaks your whole trade' and that a Snip volley is 'caught on his E dodge'.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks only. Snip Snip! is an ability and lands in full, including the true-damage centre. The lane is a stat-check early, but the reason is his base stats and Leap Strike, not his E eating your Q.
audit.corrected: Early is Jax-favoured on stats; hold autos during Counter Strike, keep sniping through it.

audit.why: Spikes read Lvl 1-2, Lvl 6, Jax first item, Late — matches Jax's Counter Strike/level 6/Trinity curve and Gwen's Riftmaker timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Empower (W) is an auto-attack reset, and Counter Strike's interaction with Gwen's Q was stated backwards. No cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s — the single longest punishable window in the matchup. Empower (W, 7/6/5/4/3s) resets his attack, so the wind-up is the burst tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Added: E dodges autos not Snip Snip!, real E cooldowns, and Empower's reset as his opener.

edits.before: Once Counter Strike is online he dodges your Snip-and-auto trade and stuns you, then Q-leaps and bursts you before you can scale.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges autos, never Snip Snip! — snip through it, hold your autos, and walk out before the counterattack stun fires.

edits.before: Land Counter Strike on your Snip volley and autos so the stun connects and your trade is denied
edits.after: Bait your autos into Counter Strike so the stun lands, then Leap Strike in with Empower's reset

edits.before: "Levels 4-5 stay rough — you have Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash to reposition, but pre-Riftmaker he can soak your whole trade on Counter Strike and Q-leap back onto you. The flip is Level 6 and Needlework: drop W as he commits so his E stun and follow-up auto get eaten while you stay untargetable to anything outside the fog, slow him with R, and out-heal him off your ability sustain. That is your one owned window. Always count his Counter Strike before you step up — a Snip volley caught on his E dodge is a free stun-and-burst for him."
edits.after: "Levels 4-5 stay rough — you have Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash to reposition, but pre-Riftmaker he can Leap Strike straight back onto you. Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks: Snip Snip! lands through it in full, so keep the cone on him and hold your autos until the counterattack stun has fired. The flip is Level 6 and Needlework: drop W as he commits so his stun and Empower auto get eaten while you stay untargetable to anything outside the fog, slow him with R, and out-heal him off your ability sustain. His E is 17s at rank 1 — that gap is your step-up."

edits.before: His Counter Strike stun into Trinity/Blade burst is the lane's scariest moment — one volley caught on his E dodge flips into a stun-and-all-in you cannot out-stat yet, even with mist down.
edits.after: His Counter Strike stun into Trinity/Blade burst is the lane's scariest moment — his Empower auto-reset is the tell, and once the stun lands the follow-up all-in out-stats you even with mist down.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Wait it out. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dodges autos, not Snip Snip!. Hold attacks, keep sniping, leave pre-stun.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges autos + stuns. Wait it out. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jax Counter Strike (17s rank 1, 9s rank 5): dodges autos only — Snip Snip! still lands. Hold autos, track it before every engage. - Your W: never spend it on chip. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos + stuns. Wait it out. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges autos, not Snip Snip! — hold autos, keep the cone on him, all-in once the stun has fired.
